blocks.text: Enhance your kitchen organization with this Kamenstein 20-Jar Stainless Steel Revolving Spice Rack for the countertop. Made of stainless steel, this rotating spice rack holds 20 jars that come filled with frequently used spices. Jars included in the spice organizer are made of glass with clearly labeled black caps that feature sifter tops for easy, mess-free dispensing when seasoning foods. Spices included in your spice rack may include basil, marjoram, garlic salt, coriander, rosemary, oregano, and more. Each jar is filled and sealed in our Massachusetts spice-bottling facility. This product is eligible for 5 years of free spice refills. Measures 13-1/2 x 8-1/2 x 8-1/2 inches. Wipe clean with a slightly dampened cloth or paper towel. Do not immerse in water.

items.label: SET INCLUDES
items.value: 1 rotating spice rack and 20 prefilled, glass spice jars with removable sifter and labeled black caps

items.label: 20 ESSENTIAL SPICES
items.value: includes basil, bay leaves, celery salt, chives, cilantro, coriander, crushed mint, dill weed, fennel seed, herbes de provence, Italian seasoning, marjoram, oregano, parsley, pizza seasoning, rosemary, savory seasoning, sea salt, seas

items.label: STYLISH STORAGE
items.value: the rotating, polished stainless steel rack keeps spices neat and easily accessible on countertops or in cabinets

items.value: evenly dispense spices to minimize mess when pouring into measuring spoons or onto food

items.value: allow you to quickly find spices while cooking and baking
